visible.message:
When a fragment calls .status() on a container created outside the fragment and opens that status block twice with separate `with` statements, the app goes blank with "Cannot set a node at a delta path". It works in 1.58.0 and fails from 1.59.0 on; I am on 1.60.0. Code:

@st.fragment
def frag(outside):
    block = outside.status('query')
    with block:
        st.code('first')
    with block:
        st.text('second')

st.title('Repro')
frag(st.container())
